source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council


    1. Proceed with consideration of Bylaw No. 1970 to amend the zoning designation of the property
       located at 757 and 765 Latoria Road from RR6A (Rural Residential 6A) and RR2 (Rural Residential 2)
       to R2 (One- and Two-Family Residential) subject to the following conditions:

            a) That the applicant provides, as a bonus for increased density, the following contributions
                 per lot prior to subdivision approval:
                          i. $660 towards the Affordable Housing Fund; and
                          ii. $3,960 towards the General Amenity Fund.
            b) That the applicant provides $113,448 to the General Amenity Reserve Fund in lieu of 5.8%
                 open space, prior to subdivision approval;
            c) That priorto Public Hearing, the applicant provides a technical memo from an engineer that
               verifies stormwater can be adequately managed on-site for the proposed
               developments, to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering;
            d) That the applicant provides, priorto Bylaw Adoption, a Section 219 covenant, registered
                 in priority of all other charges on title, that agrees:
                             i. That the following will be provided and implemented to Bylaw No. 1000
                                  standards to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering prior subdivision
                                  approval or the issuance of a building permit, whichever is first:
                                       i. Full frontage improvements; and
                                       ii. A storm water management plan;
                             ii. That a Construction Parking and Traffic Management Plan be provided to the
                                  satisfaction of the Director of Engineering prior to any alteration of the land;
                             iii. That 2,298.7 m2 of the land shall be retained as open space, with a non
                                  disturbance covenant registered for 1,225.7 m2 of land in the southwest
                                  corner of 765 Latoria Road prior to subdivision approval;

                                                                                                        March 15, 2021
                                                                                                          Page 4 of 16


                           iv. That a landscape plan shall be provided at the time of development permit
                              for the portion of open space intended to be re-planted; and
                           V. That the site is in proximity to agricultural areas and the South Vancouver
                              Island Rangers gun range, and that these may create general noise, odour,
                              and other nuisances, and agree that the owner and all future owners assume
                              all risk and annoyance of such nuisances.

source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council


   1. Direct Staff to prepare a bylaw to amend the zoning designation of the properties located at 2848
      and 2852 Millstream Road from CSl (Service Commercial) to CCl (Mixed-Use Residential
       Commercial 2) subject to the following terms and conditions:

            a) That the applicant provides, as a bonus for increased density, the following contributions
                per residential unit, prior to the issuance of a building permit:
                           i. $750towardsthe Affordable Housing Reserve Fund; and
                           ii. $2,850 towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund.
       Subject to reductions depending on the use and height in accordance with the Affordable Housing
       and Amenity Contribution Policy.

            b) That the applicant provides, prior to Public Hearing, the following:
                           i. A technical memo from an engineer that verifies storm water can be
                              adequately managed on-site for the proposed developments, to the
                              satisfaction of the Director of Engineering; and
            c) That the applicant provides, prior to Bylaw Adoption, a Section 219 covenant, registered in
                priority of all other charges on title, that agrees to the following:
                            i. That the following will be provided and implemented to Bylaw No. 1000
                                standards to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering prior to the
                              issuance of a building permit:
                                1. Full frontage improvements;
                                2. A storm water management plan; and
                                3. A construction parking management plan.
                          ii. That the building be strata titled into individual residential units prior to the
                              issuance of an occupancy permit;
                          iii. That the required parking stalls for this development are allocated for the use
                              by individuals in each unit, as required by Bylaw 300 and designed
                              accordingly, and that parking stalls are not sold or rented out individually; and

                                                                                                         March 15, 2021
                                                                                                            Page 5 of 16


                             iv. That 100% of residential parking spaces, excluding visitor parking spaces, shall
                                 feature an energized outlet capable of providing Level 2 charging or higher to
                                the parking space; and
                                  1. Energized outlets shall be labelled for the use of electric vehicle
                                      charging;
                                  2. Where an electric vehicle energy management system is implemented
                                       (load sharing), a qualified professional may specify a minimum
                                       performance standard to ensure a sufficient rate of electric vehicle
                                       charging; and
                                  3.   The owner is required to keep the Electric Vehicle Servicing Equipment
                                       (EVSE) in operation and the Strata Council may not prevent an owner,
                                       occupant, or tenant from installing the EV charging equipment.

   2.   Direct Staff to negotiate an agreement with the applicant regarding the proposed encroachment of
        staircases prior to First Reading of the bylaw, or require a redesign of the building prior to Public
        Hearing;

   3.   Authorize the Director of Planning to issue the setback variances listed in Table 3 within the Form
        and Character Development Permit for 2848 and 2852 Millstream Rd.

        following terms and conditions:
             a) That the applicant provides, prior to Public Hearing, the following:

                                  adequately managed on-site for the proposed developments, to the
                                  satisfaction of the Director of Engineering.

                  priority of all other charges on title, that agrees:

R. Havward - Number of people not able to get through on the phone during Public Hearing.

source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council:


    1. Proceed with consideration of Bylaw No. 1972 to amend the zoning designation of the property
       located at 2749 Jacklin Road from the RM2 (Attached Housing) zone to the CCl (City Centre 1) zone
        subject to the following terms and conditions:

            a) That Council waive the requirement for a Public Hearing in accordance with Sec. 464(2) of
                the Local Government Act;


            b) That Council waive amenity contributions for the 50-unit residential development proposed
               with this application, provided that it is developed as non-market housing by the Provincial
               Rental Housing Corporation, and otherwise that the owner provide as a bonus for increased
               density amenity contributions in accordance with Council Policy as prescribed in Bylaw No.
                1972;


            c) That Bylaw No. 1972 include a site-specific exception to the minimum frontage required for
                a use other than a townhouse use in the CCl Zone;

            d) That the applicant provides, prior to third reading of Bylaw No. 1972, the following:
                 i.    A technical memo from an engineer that verifies storm water can be adequately
                       managed on-site for the proposed developments, to the satisfaction of the Director
                       of Engineering.
            e) That the applicant provides, prior to third reading of Bylaw No. 1972, a Section 219
               covenant, registered in priority of all other charges on title, that agrees:
                   i.   That the following will be provided and implemented to Bylaw No. 1000 standards
                        to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering prior to the issuance of a building
                        permit:
                              a. Full frontage improvements on Jacklin Road;
                              b. A storm water management plan; and
                              c. A construction parking management plan.
                  ii.   That 100% of residential parking spaces, excluding visitor parking spaces, shall
                        feature an energized outlet capable of providing Level 2 charging or higher to the
                        parking space, and that;
                              a. Energized outlets shall be labelled for the use of electric vehicle charging;
                              b.Where an electric vehicle energy management system is implemented
                                 (load sharing), the Director of Engineering may specify a minimum
                                 performance standard to ensure a sufficient rate of electric vehicle
                                 charging; and
                              c.The owner/tenant is required to keep the Electric Vehicle Servicing
                                Equipment (EVSE) in operation and the Strata Council/landlord may not

                                                                                                    March 15, 2021
                                                                                                      Page 12 of 16


                                   prevent an owner, occupant, or tenant from installing the EV charging
                                   equipment
              f) That the applicant provides, prior to bylaw adoption, road dedication adjacent to Jacklin
                  Road to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering;
